reference: Native MuJoCo 3.3.0; 2 ms physical substeps; 20 ms policy; 100 ms RGB-D; 23 actions

units.finger_brier: mean squared probability error, two finger contacts
units.dual_fraction_mse: mean squared error vs simultaneous-contact substep fraction
units.vision_rmse_at_exposures: dimensionless pooled RGB-D features; all new real exposures within evaluated windows
units.held_start_rmse_same_exposures: same units and exact exposures; hold starting feature
units.vision_rmse_fresh_endpoint: same units; only horizons ending on a new exposure

opening_trajectory_semantics.validation_onpolicy: Recorded student-action input for open-loop. Both predictions are measured against the recorded student physical successors.
opening_trajectory_semantics.validation_recovery: Open-loop uses the teacher actions actually integrated from the restored student state. Both predictions are measured against those physical teacher successors.
opening_trajectory_semantics.validation_demo: Held-out MM-01 successful P6 demos; open-loop uses their executed teacher action. Both predictions use the same physical target.
opening_trajectory_semantics.student_imagined_closed_loop: The frozen current-round actor queries its own predicted state and causal image at every tick. It receives only starting sensors and task text. Mismatch to the recorded physical future also includes any action difference.

recovery_target: 32 consecutive, legal, actual teacher-executed 20 ms intervals from a unique prior student-visited anchor; incomplete prefixes still eligible for physical replay and independently qualified BC. Future physical states, contacts and exposures enter only the loss.

h32_loss.visual_temporal_reduction: mean over actual new exposure count

implementation_check_on_initial_recorded.scope: Wiring check against the actual student successor sequence; separate from measured teacher recovery targets and from the registered directional numerical check.

count_scope: Totals cover only new MM-02 rounds. Inherited 2,800 WM and 600 old bridge updates are separate. H32 is already included in the model paired 512 actor updates. Forward/gradient diagnostics and held-out evaluation are outside H32 optimization query counts.
timing_scope: Summed per-stage optimization wall times; WM/BC can run concurrently. Excludes loading, encoding, target collection, physics evaluation and diagnostics, so the sum is not total experiment elapsed time.
